name: Report to Anastasia
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The mages of the Undercity have noted a magical disturbance within the city, and have sent word for mages of the Horde to investigate.

Anastasia Hartwell can tell you more.  Speak with her in the Magic Quarter in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
It is true.  A magical disturbance has been detected in our city.  We are not yet sure of its origin, or whether it is malign or benign.  We must first gather more information...

And that, adventurer, brings us to your task.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 15 to 16, 3,110 XP in all.

quests.name: Investigate the Alchemist Shop
quests.objectiveText: Obtain a Cantation of Manifestation and a Chest of Containment Coffers from behind Anastasia Hartwell.

quests.name: Gathering Materials
quests.objectiveText: Bring 10 Linen Cloth and 6 Dalaran Mana Gems to Josef Gregorian.
